answer.reasoning: Both suggestions describe the same swap between the two fabricator files and propose the same fix: move each set of definitions back into the file named for it. They differ only in which file they point at, so this is a cross_location duplicate. The judges disagreed only on needsUnifiedComment. Each member already describes the whole swap and the edits to both files, so either one could replace the pair without adding anything. I set it to false. The grouping is certain, but the flag is a judgment call because the fix does touch two files.
